LESSON: ORAL PRESENTATIONS: DELIVERING SPEECHES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 10.1.1: Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What makes one a good storyteller?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use oral narrative techniques during the performance
2. appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ORAL PRESENTATIONS: DELIVERING SPEECHES
This lesson teaches Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. use oral narrative techniques during the performance
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches above.
2. Explain Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes one a good storyteller?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use oral narrative techniques during the performance
2. appreciate the importance of performance techniques in the successful delivery of oral material

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
